Nestled a stone’s throw from the turquoise waters of the West Coast National Park lagoon, our five self-catering pads are perfectly positioned for kitesurfers, couples, remote workers, and anyone needing a break from the city.</p><p data-end="973" data-start="685" style="" data-css="tve-u-19639948ea2">Langebaan is a place where time slows down. Wade through the warm, sandy-bottomed lagoon at Kraalbaai, picnic at Shark Bay, or explore nearby flower trails, wine farms, and beach restaurants. When the wind is up, the lagoon becomes a playground for kitesurfing, winging, foiling, and SUP.</p><p data-end="1270" data-start="975" style="" data-css="tve-u-19639968a10">Back at OysterRock, each apartment is stylish, open-plan, and kitted out with everything you need: your own patio, fully equipped kitchen, fast WiFi, and secure kite gear storage. The garden is a green haven—with two braai areas, a hot outdoor shower, and a big shady gazebo for lazy afternoons.</p><p data-end="1380" data-start="1272">Whether you’re chasing wind or sunsets, OysterRock offers the kind of barefoot comfort you’ll come back for.</p></div></div></div></div></div><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv-columns dynamic-group-kmyvifpe" style="--tcb-col-el-width: 1080;" data-css="tve-u-178c5c791bb"><div class="tcb-flex-row v-2 tcb--cols--3" style="" data-css="tve-u-178c5c791bc"><div class="tcb-flex-col" style=""><div class="tcb-col dynamic-group-kmyvidlk" data-css="tve-u-178c5c791bd" style=""><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv_contentbox_shortcode thrv-content-box tve-elem-default-pad dynamic-group-kmyvibdg" data-css="tve-u-178c5c791be" style="">

We look forward to welcoming you!</p></div><div class="thrv_wrapper thrv_custom_html_shortcode" data-css="tve-u-1961f91b995" style=""><a href="https://wa.me/27834482177" target="_blank">WhatsApp at +27 83 448 2177</a></div></div>
